title: Small sport management games I’ve used AI to generate.
author: arunhammer28
selftext:
I’ve made a couple of games that really are just for me to play on my commute. I’ve got no dev experience so I’ve used AI to build my concept, and through multiple iterations, in my mind some easy fun games. 

Concept is simple, I don’t have time for a full management game, so these work as draft a team for one off matches. Currently I have football and baseball, so interested in some ideas on what else I could do. I’m thinking next an F1 team management do the last race of the season. 

Anyway, let me know what you think. I’m not looking to do anything commercial with this, more looking for ideas that I’ve not thought of to make it more fun. 

[**www.managers-call.co.uk**](http://managers-call.co.uk) is where the games are hosted.
